title: smtp: TCP accept loop and main.rs
description: Implement crates/smtp/src/server.rs and crates/smtp/src/main.rs. server.rs: pub async fn run_server(config: Arc<Config>, queue: MessageQueue, shutdown: impl Future<Output=()> + Send + 'static) -> io::Result<()>. Binds two TcpListeners (port_25 and port_587 from config). Select loop: tokio::select! on listener_25.accept(), listener_587.accept(), shutdown signal. On accept: clone Arc<Config> and queue sender, spawn tokio task calling session::run_session(stream, peer_addr, config, queue). main.rs: same pattern as crates/mail/src/main.rs — parse --config flag, load config, init tracing (json/text), create MessageQueue, set up ctrl-c+SIGTERM shutdown, call run_server. Log startup: 'usenet-ipfs-smtp starting' with port_25 and port_587 fields. Graceful shutdown: stop accepting new connections, existing sessions run to completion.
